name: spider-queries-validation
description: Validation split of NL-to-SQL query examples used to measure a model's ability to translate natural language questions into correct SQL queries. It evaluates both syntactic correctness of generated SQL and semantic correctness via execution results. Commonly used to benchmark text-to-SQL and code-generation models.
reputation: Widely used and well-regarded within the NL-to-SQL community as a standard benchmark for semantic parsing and query generation.
